description: Mimecast is a cloud security platform for email. This module collects security events, operational logs, and compliance data (SIEM stream, TTP URL/Attachment/Impersonation, DLP, Audit, Threat Intel, and more) and forwards them to SEKOIA.IO.
name: Mimecast

actions.name: Block Sender
actions.description: Block a sender in Mimecast by creating a blocked senders policy.

actions.name: Permit Sender
actions.description: Allow a sender in Mimecast via the Managed Senders API.

actions.name: Delete Managed Senders
actions.description: Bulk-delete managed sender entries from Mimecast.

actions.name: Decode URL
actions.description: Decode a Mimecast-rewritten URL to its original form.

actions.name: Get Message Info
actions.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific Mimecast message.

actions.name: Get Blocked Sender Policies
actions.description: Retrieve the list of blocked sender policies from Mimecast.

actions.name: Delete Blocked Sender Policy
actions.description: Delete a blocked sender policy from Mimecast by its policy ID.

actions.name: Get Threat Events
actions.description: Retrieve threat events from Mimecast Threat Intelligence.

actions.name: Get Threat Event Details
actions.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific Mimecast threat event.

actions.name: Get Threat Stats By Attachment Scans
actions.description: Retrieve sandboxing attachment scan statistics from Mimecast.

actions.name: Get Threat Stats By Gateway Detections
actions.description: Retrieve gateway detection statistics (spam or malware) from Mimecast.

actions.name: Get Threat Stats By URL Clicks
actions.description: Retrieve malicious URL click statistics from Mimecast.

actions.name: Get Threat Stats By Impersonations
actions.description: Retrieve impersonation detection statistics from Mimecast.

actions.name: Get Threats By Sender
actions.description: Retrieve threat statistics grouped by sender from Mimecast.

actions.name: Get Threats By Recipient
actions.description: Retrieve threat statistics grouped by recipient from Mimecast.

actions.name: Get Reported Emails
actions.description: Retrieve user-reported emails from Mimecast Threat Reporting.

actions.name: Get Threat Reports
actions.description: Retrieve threat analysis reports for a reported email from Mimecast.
